definitions.BUILD_IMPROVE: Build, improve, optimize, or introduce a method/model/system intended to solve or improve the seed problem.
definitions.DIAGNOSE_STRESS_TEST: Diagnose failures, stress-test robustness/safety/generalization, or expose limitations of existing systems on the seed problem.
definitions.EXPLAIN_MECHANISM_THEORY: Explain mechanisms, provide theoretical analysis, derive guarantees, or characterize why/when phenomena occur.
definitions.MEASURE_EVALUATE: Measure, benchmark, evaluate, or construct evaluation protocols/metrics/datasets for the seed problem.
